spanish: o en urdimbre o en trama, al lino y a la lana, o en piel o en toda obra de piel,

findings.issue: פִּשְׁתִּים is masculine plural; lino is a singular mass noun (grammatical smoothing, same material).

notes: או/ב/ל/ו, warp–woof, linen–wool, skin, and all work of skin match the tokens, including the article on לַפִּשְׁתִּים and וְלַצָּמֶר.
